title: At odds over the EU budget, European leaders cut summit short - DW has more
summary: Even before they met, it was clear the gap between European leaders' demands for the EU budget would make negotiations difficult. They ended a summit meeting early and aim to agree on EU funding in…
byline: Roshni Majumdar, Sertac Comak, Kieran Burke

blocks.text: EU leaders to meet later tonight, Merz says
Contrary to earlier expectations, European Union leaders weren't quite done for the day, even if it was well past 2200 local time.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said that rather than meet again as scheduled on Friday, leaders would hold a final round of discussions around midnight and end the summit.
